claims.exact_statement: For the genuine Boolean one-point-defect gate q_n that is +1 at one point and -1 elsewhere, every coordinate conditional-label credit Gamma_n^L defined in the B05 source is strictly negative for every n>=3. For the genuine near tensor q_4 tensor q_5, the two factor-coordinate classes also have strictly negative Gamma^L. This statement concerns L only and does not by itself determine the complete physical L+Q order-swap credit.

claims.exact_statement: Let q_n be the genuine Boolean gate that is +1 at one point and -1 elsewhere. For every n>=3 and every coordinate, the complete physical selector/data order-swap credit Gamma_n^(L+Q) is strictly negative. More precisely, with delta=2^(-n), P(x)=Q(1-x,x), and Q(a,v)=(a^2+v^2) j(v^2/(a^2+v^2)), one has Gamma_n^Q=P(delta)-P(2delta)/2+2delta^2<0 and Gamma_n^L<0. The two factor-coordinate classes of q_4 tensor q_5 likewise have strictly negative L, Q, and L+Q credits.
refutes: A universal nodewise nonnegative complete physical first-credit at unchanged hypotheses
claims.first_unproved_line: No theorem here rules out signed multistep cancellation, a globally chosen restriction tree, or a nonlocal stopping-time payment.
scope_exclusions: No universal sign claim across Boolean cores; the bent control has the opposite sign.
